name: ui-apexpages-idea-controller-wave18-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: ApexPages Idea controllers are deterministic local controller contracts; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: List<Idea> seeded = [SELECT Id, Title FROM Idea ORDER BY Title]; System.assertEquals(2, seeded.size()); ApexPages.IdeaStandardController controller = new ApexPages.IdeaStandardController(); Idea current = (Idea)controller.getRecord(); current.Id = seeded[0].Id; current.Title = seeded[0].Title; System.assertEquals(seeded[0].Id, controller.getId()); System.assertEquals(seeded[0].Id, ((Idea)controller.getRecord()).Id); String expectedPage = '/' + String.valueOf(seeded[0].Id).substring(0, 15); System.assertEquals(expectedPage, controller.cancel().getUrl()); System.assertEquals(expectedPage, controller.edit().getUrl()); System.assertEquals(expectedPage, controller.view().getUrl()); System.assertNotEquals(null, controller.save()); System.assertEquals(seeded[0].Id, controller.getId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, controller.delete()); ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController setController = new ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController(); List<Object> selected = new List<Object>{seeded[1]}; setController.setSelected(selected); System.assertEquals(1, setController.getSelected().size()); System.assertEquals(seeded[1].Id, ((Idea)setController.getSelected()[0]).Id); setController.setFilterId('RecentIdeas'); System.assertEquals('RecentIdeas', setController.getFilterId()); setController.setPageSize(7); System.assertEquals(7, setController.getPageSize());
